paper_title: An analysis of vaccine-related sentiments from development to deployment   of COVID-19 vaccines
caption: : Polarity scores for Japan
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between polarity scores and corresponding counts. The x-axis is labeled “Polarity scores” and spans from -1.0 to 0.6 with a linear scale and tick marks at intervals of 0.2. The y-axis is labeled “Counts” and ranges from 0 to 40000 with a linear scale and tick marks at intervals of 10000. A single blue line with circular markers represents the data; it begins at approximately (–1.0, 1000) and gradually increases to approximately (–0.4, 13000) before declining to approximately (–0.2, 8000), then increasing to a peak of roughly 38000 at a polarity score of 0.0. The line then decreases to about 25000 at 0.2, then to about 6000 at 0.4, and finally ends at approximately (0.6, 15000).
